ios.name: VOpenKey AI: Vietnamese
ios.subtitle: Recover mistyped words
ios.promotionalText: Recover words changed during Vietnamese typing. Open snippets or an AI writing assistant with a shortcut.
ios.description:
Keep Vietnamese typing in flow. VOpenKey AI combines a Vietnamese input method with writing tools you can open from keyboard shortcuts.

Type with more control
• Choose Telex, VNI, or Simple Telex.
• Automatically restore non-Vietnamese words changed during typing, or use a shortcut to recover the current word.
• See optional, context-aware Vietnamese suggestions, including for phrases typed without diacritics.
• Convert text between supported Vietnamese encodings, including older text to Unicode.

Write with shortcuts
• Search and insert snippets in any app; search works without Vietnamese diacritics.
• Expand repeated text with custom macros.
• Open an AI writing assistant to draft, translate, or revise text. Choose a hosted service, a local model, or a supported signed-in command-line agent.
• When Codex CLI is selected, create an image from a prompt, then copy or insert it.

Tune typing rules and shortcuts to your workflow. VOpenKey AI is open source under GPL-3.0. Start by choosing an input method and the writing tools you want to use.
ios.whatsNew: The Secure Input notice identifies what's forcing English, with troubleshooting tips and quick actions to reveal it in Finder, open Activity Monitor, or copy the details. Try ready-made AI writing actions and copy a result while closing the assistant. In password fields, suggestions stay hidden and vocabulary learning pauses. Punctuation after an accepted suggestion replaces the extra space.
